WITH s6_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    fished_date_doy,
    cls,
    boat,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
    SUM(yt) as total_yt,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler
  FROM trips
  WHERE fished_date_season = 6 AND fished_date_doy >= 60
  GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls, boat
  ORDER BY fished_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC
)
SELECT fished_date_doy, cls, yt_per_angler, total_yt, boat
FROM s6_trips
WHERE fished_date_doy BETWEEN 60 AND 182
LIMIT 200

WITH daily_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    fished_date_doy as day,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(boat, cls)) as boat_class_count,
    SUM(yt) as total_yt,
    SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as avg_yt_per_angler,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cls IN ('day_1_5', 'overnight', 'full_day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_multi_day
  FROM trips
  WHERE fished_date_season = 6
  GROUP BY fished_date_doy
)
SELECT day, boat_class_count, total_yt, total_anglers, avg_yt_per_angler, has_multi_day
FROM daily_summary
WHERE day >= 150
ORDER BY day DESC

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  boat,
  yt,
  anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(yt AS FLOAT) / anglers, 2) as boat_yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6 
  AND fished_date_doy IN (94, 101, 108, 109, 115)
  AND (
    (fished_date_doy = 94 AND boat = 'Prowler' AND cls = 'overnight')
    OR (fished_date_doy = 101 AND boat = 'Prowler' AND cls = 'overnight')
    OR (fished_date_doy = 108 AND boat = 'Invicta' AND cls = 'day_1_5')
    OR (fished_date_doy = 109 AND cls = 'three_quarter')
    OR (fished_date_doy = 115 AND boat = 'Legend' AND cls = 'overnight')
  )
ORDER BY fished_date_doy

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  boat,
  yt,
  anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6 
  AND fished_date_doy IN (94, 101, 115)
  AND cls = 'overnight'
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, yt DESC
